name.title: Name
name.description: full name of the one receiving the check (the property owner).

ID.title: Id
ID.description: Owner account number assigned by the remitter/payor to the interest owner

property_id.title: PropertyId
property_id.X-ReasoningPrompt:
Your task is to extract information from a single property record that spans multiple pages.

Instructions:

Find the Context: First, scan the top of the very first page to find the Property ID. This ID is the unique identifier for the entire document.

Scan All Pages: This document is one continuous record. You must scan all pages provided.

Find the Final Value: Go to the very bottom of the last page to find the final "Total Property" value.

Connect the Data: The Property ID from Step 1 must be associated with the Total Property value from Step 3.

CRITICAL: Do NOT assume the "Total Property" is missing just because it is not on the same page as the "Property ID". The Property ID on Page 1 is the header for all data that follows, including the Total Property on the final page.

I you find no information for this property, this is a strong cue that you are mislead and that the information is on next pages. Dont worry about "check number" annotations if you find some, they are not related to the property id.

description.title: Description
description.description: well/lease name or description as printed

state.title: State
state.description: state as a 2 letter abbreviation (e.g. CA, TN, ...)

production.description: List of Production objects for this property.

type.title: Type
type.description:
Normalized Product Type

This field standardizes product type labels found on oil and gas revenue statements to make them consistent across operators and states.

Aliases:
	•	"O", "OIL SALES" → OIL
	•	"NG", "GAS SALES" → GAS
	•	"PP", "PLANT", "NGLS", "PLANT PRODUCTS" → NGL
	•	"COND" → CONDENSATE
	•	"SKIM" → SKIM (represents balancing or adjustment entries for small volume or revenue discrepancies between measured and allocated production, often due to rounding, shrinkage, or metering differences. Not a separate production stream.)
	•	"WITHHOLDING" → State withholding tax

line_items.description:
Extract each of the line items. A line item can either be: 
- a revenue event (e.g. royalty interest)
- a deduction
- a state witholding

Do not merge line items. If there is an RI line item and a deduct line item, treat them as separate lines.

type.title: Type
type.description:
The type, as reported.

If it is ROYALTY INTEREST, ROYALTY, or similar, return: RI
If it is WORKING INTEREST, return WI
If it is ORRI INTEREST, return ORRI
If it is NPRI INTEREST, return NPRI
If it is UWI INTEREST, return UWI
If the raw value is UWI but clearly denotes working interest, normalize to WI.

If it is a deduction or tax (e.g. Severance tax, processing, treating, production tax, witholding tax, marketing expense, ...), return it exactly as it is in the document

production_date.title: ProductionDate
production_date.description: Production period end date in ISO-8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

property_volume.title: PropertyVolume
property_volume.description: Property gross volume produced, exactly as reported (with as many decimal places as in the reported value).

volume_unit.title: VolumeUnit
volume_unit.description:
Unit for the volume

if OIL: return BBL

if GAS: return MCF or MMBtu

if NGL: return GAL

if CONDENSATE: return BBL

if Plant products: return BBL

property_value.title: PropertyValue
property_value.description:
Gross property value, as reported. 2-decimal rounding. 

If it is written as (X), return -X
If it is written as X, return X

owner_interest.title: OwnerInterest
owner_interest.description: Owner interest decimal between 0 and 1, rounded to 6 decimals.

distribution_interest.title: DistributionInterest
distribution_interest.description: Settlement decimal (percent of the gross property revenue the owner is owed) between 0 and 1, rounded to 6 decimals.

owner_value.title: OwnerValue
owner_value.description: The owner's share of the gross revenue as reported. DO NOT COMPUTE

line_items.title: LineItems

total_owner_volume.title: TotalOwnerVolume
total_owner_volume.description:
The total owner share volume, in bold, as written. Right next to "Total" followed by the type of production (e.g. Total GAS, Total OIL, ...). 

Do not do computations, write it only if explicitly mentioned in the document.

total_owner_value.title: TotalOwnerValue
total_owner_value.description:
The total owner share value, in bold, as written. Right next to "Total" followed by the type of production (e.g. Total GAS, Total OIL, ...) and the owner_share_volume. 

Do not do computations, write it only if explicitly mentioned in the document. This is not the property total, but the total for the individual production type.

production.title: ProductionList

total_property_value.title: TotalPropertyValue
total_property_value.description:
owner's total balance for this property. Will be next to Total Property after all its production line items. 

Do not do computations, write it only if explicitly mentioned in the document.
